window.basis: GitHub staged/modified within window or dated source captures. Source date and Git commit date are distinct.

method: Human visual review of accessible original GitHub image bytes; filename/provenance-only for large or inaccessible originals.
not_exhaustive: Local X:/EnvironmentPortfolio, Wix Media Manager, private source binaries, and historic repo file trees are not exhaustively reviewed.

candidates.name: Melusina — July EEVEE character study
candidates.reason: Strong readable character silhouette and personality; historical July sculpt/material look, not November V2 production rig.

candidates.name: River Sanctuary — Graphic Cel
candidates.reason: Authentic panorama/3D lookdev, highly legible graphic-ink palette; very wide crop, not a full cinematic 3D environment hero.

candidates.name: River Sanctuary — Sakura Dawn
candidates.reason: Same geometry/camera as Graphic Cel; useful A/B technical demonstration, not a separate environment achievement.

candidates.name: Faraway Mother — Heart Gate Plate VII
candidates.reason: Strong authentic layout/procedural-system explanation; in-frame geometry visibly incomplete. Source labels are project claims, not independently validated runtime measurements.

candidates.name: Faraway Mother — Capstone Plate VIII
candidates.reason: Useful three-view HDA/PCG architecture breakdown; small typography and unfinished terrace/house geometry. Keep metrics attributed as capture annotations.

candidates.name: Faraway Mother — outlined textile strata
candidates.reason: Interesting striped pearlescent cloth/strata but visible staging seams/guides and low camera cleanliness.

candidates.name: Faraway Mother — Heart Gate approach
candidates.reason: Procedural lace/ribbon hierarchy readable but cropped/incomplete arch and harsh staging geometry.

candidates.name: Faraway Mother — Nikki godrays
candidates.reason: Tall flat central occluder, sparse lighting and visible unfinished architecture weaken hero composition.

candidates.name: Faraway Mother — Village Twilight
candidates.reason: Greybox/simple surface fills and incomplete environmental depth; do not label twilight final.

candidates.name: Faraway Mother — Cathedral Court
candidates.reason: Promising arch volume and negative space but unfinished construction, weak framing, overbright floor.

candidates.name: Faraway Mother — COP Foundry six-panel
candidates.reason: Real six-map output evidence, captions too small; does not alone prove a live UE material cook.

candidates.name: Faraway Mother — Veil Curtain HDA multiview
candidates.reason: Genuine point/geometry multiview; meaningful as HDA process, not final draped textile rendering.

candidates.name: Melusina — Boot Skinning / KineFX
candidates.reason: Readable deformation correction and authored evidence. Clearly distinguish staged/tested gates from unverified live gait and wardrobe acceptance.

candidates.name: Lantern Post — Env Beauty 3/4
candidates.reason: Actual EEVEE source and multiple matching profile/macro/wireframe views confirmed; connector could not return full PNG for visual inspection.

candidates.name: Cross PBR — Beauty 3/4
candidates.reason: Actual EEVEE hard-surface prop pass; validate source camera, bevels, normal/roughness and matching wireframe before promotion.

candidates.name: Lantern Post — Sculpt Macro
candidates.reason: Paired source sculpt render to contrast with PBR; still requires visual inspection.

candidates.name: Chladni / Celestial Pond — Sakura Pearl
candidates.reason: Source manifest reports 128-frame 1920x1080 TD seamless composition. Not UE MRQ or verified Spout; examine 0/32/64/96 frames for temporal and image quality.

candidates.name: Chladni / Escher Ascent — Amethyst Electric
candidates.reason: 128-frame 1920x1080 TouchDesigner candidate from newly committed sequence; Unreal level capture unavailable, do not describe as an in-engine screenshot.

candidates.name: KaleidoNave — Nikki9 scene
candidates.reason: Dark/unreadable cluster with halftone treatment obscuring spatial composition; needs updated true scene render.

candidates.name: Infinity Nikki couture master
candidates.reason: Almost entirely bright near-white star-field surface; nonblank statistics do not equal usable 3D beauty art.

candidates.name: Choral Sheep — older beauty plate
candidates.reason: Clipped/overexposed wool and little readable facial form; preserve as old lookdev only.

candidates.name: Escher Sanctuary — floating stair scene
candidates.reason: Strong graphical motif and geometry silhouette, minimal environmental craftsmanship; suitable as style-system evidence.

candidates.name: Faraway Mother — 4K improvement lookbook
candidates.reason: Large 6.9 MB staged visual study. Connector did not provide image data; no quality claims until source can be opened.
